lines.beaver_en: Hello. Thank you for helping with the memorial event.
lines.learner: 아니에요. 이번 행사는 누가 주최하는 거예요?
lines.en: Not at all. Who is hosting this event?
lines.roman: Anieyo. Ibeon haengsaneun nuga juchoehaneun geoyeyo?

lines.beaver: 저희 단체가 주최해요. 순서는 어떻게 할까요?
lines.beaver_en: Our organization is hosting. How should we set the order?
lines.beaver_roman: Jeohui danchega juchoehaeyo. Sunseoneun eotteoke halkkayo?
lines.learner: 먼저 묵념을 하고 추도사를 읽으면 좋겠어요.
lines.en: I think we should first hold a silent prayer, then read the eulogy.
lines.roman: Meonjeo mungnyeomeul hago chudosareul ilgeumyeon jokesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 좋아요. 조문객은 몇 명쯤 올 것 같아요?
lines.beaver_en: Good. About how many mourners will come?
lines.beaver_roman: Joayo. Jomungaegeun myeot myeongjjeum ol geot gatayo?
lines.learner: 조문객이 이백 명쯤 올 거예요. 행렬이 길겠어요.
lines.en: About two hundred mourners will come. The procession will be long.
lines.roman: Jomungaegi ibaek myeongjjeum ol geoyeyo. Haengnyeori gilgesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그럼 행렬은 묘지까지 걸어가는 게 좋겠죠?
lines.beaver_en: Then the procession should walk to the graveyard, right?
lines.beaver_roman: Geureom haengnyeoreun myojikkaji georeoganeun ge joketjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 영정을 앞세우고 묘지까지 천천히 걸어가요.
lines.en: Yes, we'll walk slowly to the graveyard with the portrait in front.
lines.roman: Ne, yeongjeongeul apseugo myojikkaji cheoncheonhi georeogayo.

lines.beaver_en: When should we lay the remains to rest?
lines.learner: 유골은 행렬이 묘지에 도착한 후에야 모실 수 있어요.
lines.en: We can lay the remains only after the procession reaches the graveyard.
lines.roman: Yugoreun haengnyeori myojie dochakan hueya mosil su isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 그렇군요. 근처 기념관도 오늘 개관한다고 들었어요.
lines.beaver_en: I see. I heard the nearby memorial hall opens today too.
lines.beaver_roman: Geureokunyo. Geuncheo ginyeomgwando oneul gaegwanhandago deureosseoyo.
lines.learner: 그럼 행사 후에 기념관에서 사진을 볼 수 있겠네요.
lines.en: Then we can see the photos at the memorial hall after the event.
lines.roman: Geureom haengsa hue ginyeomgwaneseo sajineul bol su itgenneyo.

lines.beaver_en: How should we do the closing ceremony?
lines.learner: 마지막에 다 같이 추모곡을 부르고 마쳐요.
lines.en: At the end, we'll all sing a memorial song and finish.
lines.roman: Majimage da gachi chumogogeul bureugo machyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 이 행사를 우리 시로 유치하기가 쉽지 않았어요.
lines.beaver_en: It wasn't easy to bring this event to our city.
lines.beaver_roman: I haengsareul uri siro yuchihagiga swipji anasseoyo.
lines.learner: 알아요. 많은 분들이 애써서 유치했다고 들었어요.
lines.en: I know. I heard many people worked hard to bring it here.
lines.roman: Arayo. Maneun bundeuri aesseoseo yuchihaetdago deureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What time should we close the venue?
lines.learner: 여섯 시쯤 폐장하면 좋겠어요. 정리도 할게요.
lines.en: Closing around six would be good. I'll help clean up too.
lines.roman: Yeoseot sijjeum pyejanghamyeon jokesseoyo. Jeongnido halgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Thank you so much for your hard work today.
lines.learner: 감사합니다. 뜻깊은 추모 행사에 함께해서 좋았어요.
lines.en: Thank you. I was glad to be part of such a meaningful memorial.
lines.roman: Gamsahamnida. Tteutgipeun chumo haengsae hamkkehaeseo joasseoyo.
